_comment: Board families (catalog labels) whose packs cannot play in VPinball today, and why, in one line. Only confirmed families belong here (the 'In VPinball' items of docs/families/*.md are read from PinMAME's snd_alt.cpp, not from VPinball's PinMAME plugin or libaltsound). build_site.py copies it into catalog.json: vpx_not_playable (label -> reason) and vpx_playable: false on each entry of these families.

sam.en: AltSound does not receive this board's sound commands today: SAM games play their calls in their own code.
sam.fr: AltSound ne reçoit pas aujourd'hui les commandes son de cette carte : les jeux SAM jouent leurs appels dans leur propre code.

p2k.en: AltSound does not receive this board's sound commands today: Pinball 2000's requests go from the PC to the board outside PinMAME's sound command path.
p2k.fr: AltSound ne reçoit pas aujourd'hui les commandes son de cette carte : les requêtes du Pinball 2000 vont du PC à la carte hors du chemin des commandes son de PinMAME.
